members.label: TD-3
members.differences: Behringer's copy of the TB-303's circuit, in a smaller case with the same kind of step sequencer. It adds what the original never had: a distortion stage modelled on the Boss DS-1 guitar pedal (drive, tone and level), an input into the filter, a sync input, CV and gate outputs, and MIDI and USB.

members.label: TB-303
members.differences: The original, Roland's 1981 bass line: one oscillator switched between sawtooth and square, a resonant low-pass filter swept by one envelope, and the accent and slide of its own step sequencer. No distortion, no input into the filter and no MIDI.
